problem: Consider a matrix equation ${A}^{-1}B\,x=d,$ where $A$ and $B$ are $6\times 6$ non-singular matrices, while $x$ and $d$ are $6\times 1$ column vectors. Solve the equation for $x.$

activity_context.topic_title: Solving Systems of Equations Using Inverse Matrices

feedback.problem:
Solve the following system of linear equations by finding the inverse of the coefficient matrix:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x-z=0 \\ x+y+3z=2 \\ 3x-2y+z=4\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
We wish to write this system in the form $Ax=b$, where $A$ is a $3\times 3$ matrix and $x$ and $b$ are $3\times 1$ column vectors. We can do this as follows:

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & -1 \\ 1 & 1 & 3 \\ 3 & -2 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 2 \\ 4\end{aligned}].
$$

Now, the solution to $Ax=b$ is given by $x={A}^{-1}b.$ So, we compute ${A}^{-1}$ as follows:

*Step 1:*

$$
\begin{aligned}det(A) & =|\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & -1 \\ 1 & 1 & 3 \\ 3 & -2 & 1\end{aligned}| \\  & =1|\begin{aligned}1 & 3 \\ -2 & 1\end{aligned}|-0|\begin{aligned}1 & 3 \\ 3 & 1\end{aligned}|-1|\begin{aligned}1 & 1 \\ 3 & -2\end{aligned}| \\  & =1(1-3(-2))+0-1(-2-3) \\  & =1+6+2+3 \\  & =12.\end{aligned}
$$

*Step 2:*

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}|\begin{aligned}1 & 3 \\ -2 & 1\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}1 & 3 \\ 3 & 1\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}1 & 1 \\ 3 & -2\end{aligned}| \\ |\begin{aligned}0 & -1 \\ -2 & 1\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}1 & -1 \\ 3 & 1\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 3 & -2\end{aligned}| \\ |\begin{aligned}0 & -1 \\ 1 & 3\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}1 & -1 \\ 1 & 3\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 1 & 1\end{aligned}|\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}7 & -8 & -5 \\ -2 & 4 & -2 \\ 1 & 4 & 1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

*Step 3:*

$$
C=[\begin{aligned}7 & 8 & -5 \\ 2 & 4 & 2 \\ 1 & -4 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$

*Step 4:*

$$
{C}^{T}=[\begin{aligned}7 & 2 & 1 \\ 8 & 4 & -4 \\ -5 & 2 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$

*Step 5:*

$$
{A}^{-1}=\frac{1}{det(A)}{C}^{T}=\frac{1}{12}[\begin{aligned}7 & 2 & 1 \\ 8 & 4 & -4 \\ -5 & 2 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$

Hence

$$
\begin{aligned}x & ={A}^{-1}b \\  & =\frac{1}{12}[\begin{aligned}7 & 2 & 1 \\ 8 & 4 & -4 \\ -5 & 2 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}0 \\ 2 \\ 4\end{aligned}] \\  & =\frac{1}{12}[\begin{aligned}8 \\ -8 \\ 8\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}\frac{2}{3} \\ -\frac{2}{3} \\ \frac{2}{3}\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Hence the solution is $x=\frac{2}{3},y=-\frac{2}{3},z=\frac{2}{3}.$
